summary: Verified ORA GUIDE mascot global rendering per founder request. Logged in as test@aurem.dev on preview (bin-context-pat.preview.emergentagent.com). Confirmed OraGuideMascot renders globally from App.jsx (line 348) and is visible on all authenticated pages tested (/dashboard, /projects, /settings). Click behavior verified — opens the 'ORA GUIDE' suggestion bubble anchored to bottom-right, showing project-scoped findings with 'Open Advisor' and 'Close' actions.
critical_code_review_comments: OraGuideMascot.jsx is 562 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting STAGE_COPY/suggestion fetching into hooks if adding more features.

HIDE_PREFIXES in GlobalHelpFAB.jsx is imported by OraGuideMascot via shouldHide() — dual ownership is fine but worth a comment that /admin is intentionally excluded from the mascot (confirmed rendering NOT on /admin in this test).
Post-login flow surfaced a 403 on one XHR (unidentified endpoint) — noise, not blocking, but worth silencing if it's the /auth/me/funnel-stage poll returning 403 for admins.

Main agent may want to confirm which specific page/screenshot the founder saw the mascot missing on before further work.
rca_of_the_issue: No bug reproduced. Mascot renders as designed on all in-scope authenticated routes. shouldHide() (GlobalHelpFAB.jsx L31-34) correctly hides on /login, /signup, /verify, /support, /demo, /bug-hunt, /why-ora, /both, /admin, /dev/* and exact '/'. All other auth routes get the mascot via App.jsx L348 top-level <OraGuideMascot /> outside <Suspense>/router boundaries. If the founder's screenshot shows mascot missing on e.g. /dashboard, likely causes to investigate: (a) session/localStorage.aurem_token missing at render time causing loggedIn=false path in mascot; (b) z-index conflict — mascot uses Z_FLOATING_GUIDE from lib/zIndex.js — worth verifying no modal has higher z-index blocking it; (c) shouldHide false-positive on a URL that startsWith('/support') e.g. /support-tickets or similar; (d) production-only build issue (I only tested preview, not auremcto.com prod — per test_credentials.md founder prod password is redacted, cannot test there).
